bend_final.why: only reaches the diffuse share of a route whose final bend differs from its coarse one: not met

corner_relax.why: second corner pass changes the route only where a corner grazes a lintel: not met

corner_step_first.why: a speed shortcut (same corners, fewer traces): position 0 must give the same voices (this IS the check)

corner_wedge.why: close corners bend as one wedge

door_3d.why: door leaf in 3-D (the ajar door of pba_tworooms, boombox door of pba_demo)

door_leaf_portal.why: door leaf modelled as its doorway: the sweep scenes do not have a line crossing a leaf

edge_bound.why: needs a route and the transmission through the same obstacle: not met on these scenes

edge_dup_best.why: needs a same-way route and edge: not met

edge_dup_blend.why: needs a route near an edge apex: not met

edge_dup_mix.why: needs a same-way route and edge: not met

edge_leg_doors.why: needs an edge way whose legs meet one door leaf: not met

enable.why: master switch, read by the hooks (A.Enabled), not by P.Compute; covered by the battery preflight and ab_counts

far_muffle.why: hook-level cheap muffle beyond lod_dist (A.FarMuffle), outside P.Compute; far_muffle test

far_sliced.why: schedules far paths over frames (cl_render), outside a direct P.Compute

group_time.why: repeat-sound memo of the sound hook, outside a direct P.Compute call on cold positions

handback_speech.why: silent-line safety net of the relay (speech handed back to the engine), outside P.Compute

keep_dsp.why: DSP of the sound kept when muffled (render time)

long_lipsync.why: lip sync of long lines (cl/sv loops)

loops_native_fail.why: hands a loop the module cannot play back to the engine (loop lifecycle), outside P.Compute

model_soft_cull.why: needs paths past max_paths / reject_db within 6 dB: not met on these scenes

native_slot_fade.why: native module render (needs the module and native rendering)

native_traces.why: probe-link traces through the module: needs the module and the probe graph builds; not in P.Compute of these scenes

oneshot_follow.why: following of short sounds while they play

path_props.why: no props on the sweep scenes (path_obstruction / vehicle_obstacle tests)

route_pos_straight.why: needs a probe route whose corners all lie on the line: not met

trans_bundle.why: bundle of lines for the transmission

trans_bundle_edge.why: needs a line beside a door leaf: not met

trans_leaf_fade.why: needs a line through the world and a door leaf a route owns: not met

trans_pos_clamp.why: needs the listener closer than 2 u to the last wall exit: not met

trans_route.why: needs the probe graph and a floor between source and listener: not met

trans_tilt.why: needs a transmission through several walls of unequal muffling: not met

trans_window_soft.why: only matters when a transmission voice sits past trans_window_db of the dominant voice: no such couple on these scenes

water_planes.why: no water on the sweep scenes (water_planes test: d1_canals_06)

loops_release_restart.why: engine replay of a long one-shot when pba is turned off midway (relay/lifecycle), outside P.Compute

loops_speaker_native.why: long speaker lines rendered by the module vs an engine patch (native rendering), outside P.Compute

doors_spawned.why: doors created after map load followed or counted shut (door tracking), outside P.Compute
